background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook and with no rating move on the record. The shape is a custodian's: leverage of 8.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, CET1 of 12.0% is a touch below the median, and LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter, which looks thin for a bank whose deposits are largely operational balances from institutional clients. Capital has drifted down, CET1 by 0.9 points and leverage by 0.6 points since 31 Mar 2025, with LCR broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). Earnings beat expectations in July, and nothing flagged in the last 90 days bears on credit standing.
